Priya (PM): Dropped a Figma for a more compact trace header on the drilldown pane. Main asks: where should export actions live, how do we surface correlation IDs, and what's the expected copy payload for "Copy trace"? Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc987/compact-trace-header
Alex (Design): I like a compact header (service | status chip | short error). Proposal: put global exports in the header right (Download .json, Copy stack) and keep trace-specific quick actions (copy id, open timeline) on the correlation pill. Visual: small chevron on the pill to reveal quick actions.
Noor (Eng): Implementation note: two tiers — header actions (bulk/download) are cheap. Per-trace actions may need extra data. If we only show a 1-line error in the list, expanding to full stack requires fetching trace payload. Suggest: inline cache for visible traces + on-demand fetch for expand.
Simon (A11y): Accessibility checklist: pill must be keyboard focusable and have `aria-haspopup` and `aria-expanded`. Menu items should be real buttons with clear `aria-label`s e.g., "Copy correlation ID". If we copy text, make sure there's an announced status.
Priya (PM): Good. For copy payload I'm thinking minimal but useful: "Trace ID: {{id}}\nService: {{service}}\nStatus: {{status}}\nMessage: {{short_msg}}\n\nStack:\n{{frame1}}\n{{frame2}}\n..." Any objections?
Noor (Eng): That payload works. Small thing: when copying stack we should prefer a flattened human-readable format (file:line - function). Example copy function pseudocode:
```
const payload = `Trace ID: ${id}\nService: ${svc}\n\n${frames.map(f=>`${f.file}:${f.line} - ${f.fn}`).join('\n')}`
await navigator.clipboard.writeText(payload)
```
Alex (Design): Copy feedback: after copy show a subtle inline toast "Trace copied" with an "Open" link. For keyboard users the toast should be announced and focusable if it has a link. Also microcopy: label the header action as "Download trace (.json)" not just "Download".
Simon (A11y): Toasts should use `role=status` for polite announcement and be placed at the end of the DOM region so screen readers don't miss it. Also ensure contrast ratios for status chips meet 4.5:1.
Priya (PM): About correlation IDs: sometimes traces have multiple IDs (request vs span). We should show the primary one and a small "more" affordance that opens a list. That list should allow copy per-ID.
Noor (Eng): For permalinks I recommend a shortlink service `/go/:short` rather than pasting the full blob URL. Backend will create short IDs and we can expire or rotate them. Copying should write the shortlink not the full internal path. That reduces noise in logs and is nicer UX.
Alex (Design): Mobile behavior: long-press pill to open quick actions; on desktop show chevron menu. Keep pill max width 220px and truncate. Use a small copy icon next to the ID in the menu, not inside the pill itself.
Simon (A11y): For the expandable list of IDs, use `role=list` and `role:listitem`. Announce count in the trigger: "Show other correlation IDs (3)". For copy success use `aria-live=\"polite\"` messages.
DeployBot: deploy:trace-ui/feature/compact-header succeeded in staging at 2026-03-22T14:02Z :white_check_mark:
Priya (PM): Nice. Action items: 1) Alex - update Figma with header actions + pill behavior 2) Noor - prototype copy and shortlink endpoint (`/go/:id`) 3) Simon - produce a11y acceptance tests for menu and toast 4) PM - decide preload budget (top 3 traces).
Alex (Design): I'll add an explicit note about chip color tokens and include contrast options. ETA EOD.
Noor (Eng): I'll put up a tiny spike tomorrow with a shortlink PoC and clipboard handler.
Simon (A11y): I'll write the keyboard-flow steps and aria examples today.
Priya (PM): Thanks team — drop comments on Figma for layout tweaks to keep this thread tidy. :sparkles:
